scope: The shipped recipe, end to end, on the full 1460-frame measured-pattern panel

result.recall_by_range: identical at every range from 10 to 300 m
result.wall_s: 430.4 -> 316.5, i.e. 26 per cent faster over the whole panel
result.verdict: every metric byte-identical to the pre-change baseline

reading: the two shipped runtime changes - the object-chain filter and the background refit by distance travelled - cost nothing in detection quality when measured end to end on the full labelled panel, and together with the thread setting they cut the panel's wall time by a quarter. The panel's own declared criterion (event recall >= 0.95) remains unmet at 0.802, before and after, and is reported as the standing gap it is.
